objective.text: Treat transport acceptance as a handoff rather than proof of inbox delivery.

difficulty.rationale: Interpret the framework’s send completion at the transport boundary rather than promising recipient delivery.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A MessageSent event is observed after the configured transport accepts a message. Can the application conclude that the recipient has read it or that it reached the inbox rather than a spam folder?

options.text: No; MessageSent proves only that a Blade template was compiled, before any transport call.
options.rationale: That understates the event: it follows the successful transport operation rather than mere template compilation.
options.misconception: That understates the event: it follows the successful transport operation rather than mere template compilation.

options.text: Yes; MessageSent is emitted only after the recipient opens the email.
options.rationale: The mailer has no such read acknowledgment in its ordinary send lifecycle.
options.misconception: The mailer has no such read acknowledgment in its ordinary send lifecycle.

options.text: No; it confirms transport handoff, while downstream delivery and reading require separate evidence.
options.rationale: The framework event describes completion of its transport send operation, not the recipient server’s later classification or user behavior.

options.text: Yes for inbox delivery, because successful transport acceptance excludes later bounces.
options.rationale: A downstream system can still reject, bounce or classify an accepted message later.
options.misconception: A downstream system can still reject, bounce or classify an accepted message later.
